{{Quote|Pretty scary, huh?"<br />"What is that?"<br />"They call him the Dark One, who tempts and denies. Now me, I'm the Good One. I'm the guy that keeps on givin'.|Sonniod and Kylie Renoren|<ref name="egas">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>}}
'''Sonniod''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] for several years during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. Originally a [[Holodrama/Legends|holofeature]] delivery man for a large [[Holotheater/Legends|holotheater]] chain, Sonniod got into smuggling after delivering a shipment of illicit [[Chak-root/Legends|chak-root]] for his cousin, and took to the trade eagerly. For a [[Time/Legends|time]], Sonniod was a member of a group of smugglers led by [[Roa]], where he became friends with a brash young [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] named [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Sonniod eventually left the smuggling profession and went legitimate, although he continued to maintain contacts in the smuggling world. He eventually became involved in a scheme in the desolate [[Kamar Badlands]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], where he helped to start a [[Cult of Varn|cult]] among the native [[Kamarian Badlander]]s which he exploited for personal gain.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Uh, well an old acquaintance, Sonniod showed up. I know him from way back, and he used to do a little work smuggling copies of holofeatures. He could get a few spares for us and we could rake in more credits.|Han Solo, to [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="hsc" />}}
As a young man, Sonniod entered the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] business as a favor for his cousin, who ran a [[Cantina/Legends|"meeting place"]] on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] run by a cult that had banned most forms of revelry. At the time, Sonniod was contracting for a [[Holotheater/Legends|holotheater]] chain, flying his small [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] across 50 different backwater [[Star system/Legends|systems]], delivering the newest [[Holodrama/Legends|holofeatures]] and maintaining their [[Holoprojector/Legends|projection equipment]]. His cousin had a secret side business selling [[Chak-root/Legends|chak-root]], and turned to Sonniod when he previous supplier, a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] named [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], quit after a run-in with law enforcement. As Sonniod frequented the world in the past, he was able to avoid the cult's suspicion, although he nearly gave himself away in his nervousness. However, it proved to be a lucrative run, convincing Sonniod to give the smuggling trade a go for real. After several months, Sonniod started to develop contacts within his new business, eventually joining an organization of smugglers led by a man named [[Roa]]. Incidentally, one of his new fellows was Han Solo, the man who indirectly got him into smuggling in the first place.<ref name="hsc" />

[[File:Kamarian-AE.png|thumb|left|200px|Sonniod helped start a cult among the insectoid Kamarian natives of the Kamar Badlands.]]
Sonniod had some lucrative times over the next few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] working for Roa, he had numerous brushes with [[Death/Legends|death]] that prompted him to start thinking about his future. Ultimately valuing having a long life over the profits that could be made in the smuggling trade, Sonniod went into business as a legitimate cargo hauler, hustling from one frontier world to another. Although a little less exciting and it paid a little less, it was much safer, and allowed him from time to time to encounter old friends.<ref name="hsc" /> One of those run-ins occurred in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], when his old partner Solo contracted him to visit him on the remote, desolate [[Kamar Badlands|Badlands]] of [[Kamar/Legends|Kamar]], where the smuggler had started a new scheme while touched down repairing his damaged [[Starship/Legends|ship]]: screening holofeatures for the primitive [[Kamarian Badlander]]s, who paid handsomely to repeatedly watch the [[holodocumentary]] ''[[Varn, World of Water]]''. Solo feared that his customers would soon grow tired of seeing the same film over and over, so he asked Sonniod to bring him another feature to play. On short notice, the only feature Sonniod could find was ''[[Love is Waiting]]'', a romantic musical&mdash;Sonniod planned to swap it with a renter he knew on the way back, picking up a few extra [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] out of the deal.<ref name="hsr" />

Sonniod met with Solo and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] companion [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] on Kamar, where he was shocked with how the united the Badlanders were in their interest in Solo's feature. But when the show started&mdash;and the crowd saw ''Love is Waiting'' instead of ''Varn, World of Water''&mdash;the insectoid Badlanders began to riot. To his shock, Sonniod realized that Solo had unwittingly started a [[Cult of Varn|cult]] among his nightly audience: they were awed by the travelogue's depiction of a world covered by [[Water/Legends|water]], and what Solo had thought had been their paid admission was actually more akin to a religious offering. The Badlanders' fury quickly turned toward the offworlders, forcing Sonniod, Solo and Chewbacca to hurry back into the safety of Solo's ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]''. Narrowly escaping danger, Solo returned Sonniod back to his ship, and the two parted on friendly terms.<ref name="hsr" />

The bizarre encounter on Kamar gave Sonniod an idea, however. He could simply buy another holoprojector and a new copy of ''Varn, World of Water'' and reinstitute Solo's scheme, while organizing a couple of "[[Priest/Legends|priests]]" to continue raking in the profits while he continued his regular trade route. His efforts resulted in a renewal of the "Cult of Varn," and he in turn made a fortune in pottery and trade goods, which he sold to collectors for respectable prices. He even became incorporated into the cult's mythology, being hailed as a prophet who forswore his friendship with "Solohan the Deceiver" to carry on the blessed word of Varn.<ref name="hsc" /> He later told his story to a visiting scientist named [[Kylie Renoren]], who was horrified at how Sonniod's cult had turned Solo&mdash;who went on to become one of the most revered heroes of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]&mdash;into a demon.<ref name="egas" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Don't you stop and analyze things, ever? You've been showing them holos of a world with more water than they'd ever dreamed existed, filled with cultures and life forms that they've never even fantasized about. You haven't set up a holotheater, you idiot; you've started a religion!|Sonniod, to Han Solo|<ref name="hsr" />}}
Sonniod had an uncertain and nervous start to his smuggling career, but he soon discovered a flair and a talent for his new trade, taking to it eagerly. But after losing a number of friends and acquaintances over the course of his time in the business, he realized that he would rather have a long life than the money he could be making in smuggling, and went legitimate. He still maintained many contacts and friendships in his old business, however, and took joy in the encounters he had with his acquaintances from his past life.<ref name="hsc" /> That included Han Solo, with whom he continued to maintain a friendship&mdash;Sonniod was often critical of his old running partner, but had a keen interest in the Corellian's well-being and occasionally helped guide him towards jobs. He was also friendly with Solo's partner Chewbacca, whom he'd always liked.<ref name="hsr" /> But while he had left illegal activities behind, he still maintained an extremely keen business sense and an eye for a profit, and was willing to go so far as to exploit the religious sensibilities of the Kamarian Badlanders if he saw money in the deal.<ref name="hsc" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sonniod first appeared in ''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]'', a novel written by [[Brian Daley]] and released in [[1993]].<ref name="hsr" /> He was first pictured by [[Mike Vilardi]] in [[1993]]'s ''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]'', where much of his backstory was provided for the first time.<ref name="hsc" /> [[Sonniod]] was later reintroduced into the [[Canon]] timeline in [[Jason Fry]]'s [[2018]] ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Tales from Vandor]]'', where he once again appears as an old smuggling friend of Han Solo's.<ref name="solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Tales from Vandor]]''</ref>
